title: Advanced English Composition 11
modules: Some Basic Principles Of Good Writing……….……
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a short, written document which addresses specific people or groups for the purpose of giving information or generating an action for specific reasons."
A memorandum is a short, written document which addresses specific people or groups for the purpose of giving information or generating an action for specific reasons.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the prerequisites for graduation."
Remember that the long essay is one of the prerequisites for graduation.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used to separate subsections but if one of them already has a comma, then a semicolon is used."
Please note that commas are used to separate subsections but if one of them already has a comma, then a semicolon is used.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a daily report on the medical condition of the patients under their care. 3.2.2 Progress Report These are periodic or progress reports written at regular intervals."
Theirs is a daily report on the medical condition of the patients under their care. 3.2.2 Progress Report These are periodic or progress reports written at regular intervals.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the group of items in a simple sentence or clause after the removal of the subject."
The predicate refers to the group of items in a simple sentence or clause after the removal of the subject.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the line of action to be taken based on the conclusions drawn from the findings."
Recommendations are the line of action to be taken based on the conclusions drawn from the findings.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a compulsory part of the speech and it must indicate the speaker, the audience, the venue and the date."
The title is a compulsory part of the speech and it must indicate the speaker, the audience, the venue and the date.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a talk to an audience or a group of people gathered in a particular place for a particular reason."
A speech is a talk to an audience or a group of people gathered in a particular place for a particular reason.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means of choosing supervisors for their students."
Different institutions have different means of choosing supervisors for their students.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an acronym for a French expression which means 'Repondez s'il vous plait' which means 'Please respond'."
RSVP is an acronym for a French expression which means 'Repondez s'il vous plait' which means 'Please respond'.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means absent with apology. 3.3 Preamble This is not a compulsory part or feature of minutes of meetings."
Abswa means absent with apology. 3.3 Preamble This is not a compulsory part or feature of minutes of meetings.
